F13–F24 是 Windows 支持的虚拟功能键，虽然普通键盘通常没有这些物.en: F13–F24 are virtual function keys supported by Windows. These keys generally do not directly produce text characters, making them more suitable for this purpose.

因此，本脚本增加了微信、QQ 和 Steam 的前台检测：这些软件处于前台时会自.en: Therefore, this script adds foreground detection for WeChat, QQ, and Steam: these programs will automatically pause simulated input when in the foreground. If abnormal login prompts, shortcut key failures, or other issues occur, it is recommended to stop the script immediately.

程序提供了修饰键检测和冷却机制，但无法完全避免真实输入与模拟输入之间的竞争。.en: The program provides modifier key detection and cooldown mechanism, but it cannot completely avoid competition between real input and simulated input.

Windows 对部分系统窗口或高权限程序的访问存在限制，例如任务管理器可能无法.en: Windows restricts access to certain system windows or high-privilege programs. For example, Task Manager may not be properly recognized by a Python script with normal permissions. The current version will automatically pause when it cannot recognize the foreground window to avoid sending input in an unknown window.

首先检查脚本是否显示「连点器恢复」。如果显示自动暂停，需要检查是不是微信、QQ、.en: First check if the script displays "Clicker Recovery." If it shows auto pause, you need to check whether WeChat, QQ, or Steam is in the foreground, or if there is a modifier key cooldown time that has not ended. The effect may vary with different simulation input methods, and it cannot guarantee successful counting on all devices.

可能是模拟键盘事件与真实修饰键发生重叠。程序会在检测到修饰键后暂停，但第一次按键.zh: 可能是模拟键盘事件与真实修饰键发生重叠。程序会在检测到修饰键后暂停，但第一次按键可能已经受到影响。可以适当延长冷却时间，但这不是彻底解决方案。如果对正常键盘使用有较高要求，建议手动暂停后再操作。
可能是模拟键盘事件与真实修饰键发生重叠。程序会在检测到修饰键后暂停，但第一次按键.en: It may be that the simulated keyboard events overlap with real modifier keys. The program will pause when it detects a modifier key, but the first keystroke might have already been affected. You can appropriately extend the cooldown time, but this is not a complete solution. If you have high requirements for normal keyboard use, it is recommended to manually pause before operating.
